title: IMS Component Schema
description: Parameter definitions for IMS (Item Management System) custom recognitions/actions. Referenced by custom.recognition.schema.json / custom.action.schema.json.

AddItemDataParam.title: AddItemData Param
AddItemDataParam.description: Parameters for AddItemData action (A3). Same as SyncItemData recognition: one IconRecognition pass on the rewards grid (grid_type defaults to rewards, deduplicate=false), OCR quantity from each cell_box, then add positive deltas into the IMS cache. No multi-pass / green-mask rescan. Does not change readiness / last_sync. Best practice: use under CloseRewardsButton recognition, then next to click-close; custom_action_param may be {}.

grid_type.title: Grid Type
grid_type.description: IconRecognition grid_type. Omit to default to rewards.

roi.title: ROI
roi.description: Optional 1280x720 ROI [x,y,w,h]. Omit to use the IconRecognition reference ROI for grid_type.

item_filters.title: Item Filters
item_filters.description: IconRecognition item_filters for the candidate set. Omit/empty to use rewards defaults (Isolate:* + ValuableDepot:*). When combined with item_ids, AddItemData unions expanded filters with item_ids before recognition.

item_ids.title: Item IDs
item_ids.description: Extra IconRecognition catalog IDs to include. With item_filters, AddItemData uses the union (not IconRecognition intersection). Alone, IDs are recognized with covering category filters.

ItemDataReadyParam.title: ItemDataReady Param
ItemDataReadyParam.description: Parameters for ItemDataReady recognition. Reports whether the in-process inventory cache is ready (has a successful sync and is within TTL).

refresh_days.title: Refresh Days
refresh_days.description: Cache TTL in days after a successful sync. 1 / 7 / 30 expire after that many days; 0 means never expire due to age (still requires hasData). Omit to default to 7.

ItemQuantitySatisfiedParam.title: ItemQuantitySatisfied Param
ItemQuantitySatisfiedParam.description: Parameters for ItemQuantitySatisfied recognition (R1). Default mode evaluates a boolean expression over cached IconRecognition item IDs via {ITEM_ID} placeholders (same operators as ExpressionRecognition). report_only mode accepts exactly one {ITEM_ID}, announces current quantity, and always hits. Does not check readiness; combine with ItemDataReady via And when needed. Missing item counts as 0. UI Focus announce is off by default unless report_only is true.

expression.title: Expression
expression.description: Boolean expression over cached item quantities. Use {ITEM_ID} placeholders with IconRecognition IDs (missing item = 0). Supports + - * / % < <= > >= == != && || ! and parentheses. Result must be boolean. When report_only is true, expression must contain exactly one {ITEM_ID}.

notify_ui.title: Notify UI
notify_ui.description: When true, print the resolved expression to UI Focus (throttled). Default false. Ignored when report_only is true (report mode always announces).

report_only.title: Report Only
report_only.description: When true, require exactly one {ITEM_ID}, announce "current ITEM : quantity", and always return recognition hit. Multi-item expressions are rejected.

UpdateItemQuantityParam.title: UpdateItemQuantity Param
UpdateItemQuantityParam.description: Parameters for UpdateItemQuantity action (A1). Applies a signed delta to one cached item; result is clamped to >= 0. Persists IMS.json but does not change readiness / last_sync (only SyncItemData marks sync).

item.title: Item
item.description: IconRecognition item ID (same keys as IMS.json cache).

delta.title: Delta
delta.description: Signed quantity change (positive gain, negative spend).

SyncItemDataParam.title: SyncItemData Param
SyncItemDataParam.description: A2 screen sync. Prefer IconRecognition via grid_type + item_filters (full-grid scan of everything on screen); quantity OCR from each cell_box. Optional items map covers OCR-only nodes (top-bar currencies). Provide grid_type and/or items. Results are written to debug/record/IMS.json with updated_at.

grid_type.title: Grid Type
grid_type.description: Required for IconRecognition scan. Use valuables for 贵重品库.

roi.title: ROI
roi.description: Optional 1280x720 ROI [x,y,w,h] for IconRecognition. Omit to use the reference ROI for grid_type.

item_filters.title: Item Filters
item_filters.description: IconRecognition item_filters for the candidate set (e.g. ValuableDepot:SpecialItem). Narrows IR templates only; IMS caches every match returned.

items.title: OCR / And+box_index Items
items.description: Map of cache item ID -> pipeline recognition node for quantities outside IconRecognition (top-bar currencies, shop digits, etc.). The node may be pure OCR, or And with box_index pointing at the OCR digit result. Keys always participate in page_dedup=false region rebuild (miss removes the ID).

deduplicate.title: Deduplicate
deduplicate.description: IconRecognition deduplicate flag. Default true for A2 (one stack per item_id).

page_dedup.title: Page Dedup
page_dedup.description: When false (default), region-rebuild: clear cache IDs matching item_filters in IconRecognition recognition_items.json, plus all keys in items; then write hits. When true, merge and overwrite hit IDs only (used after paging).

notify_ui.title: Notify UI
notify_ui.description: When true (default), print each hit item name and quantity to UI Focus (ims.sync_item_found). Set false for silent scans (e.g. scene-jump side-cache).
